name: codecomfy-vscode
description: Drive ComfyUI from VS Code — image, video, audio, 3D, and image understanding. 27 verified workflows, with missing nodes and models named before anything runs.

codecomfy.nextGalleryPath.description: Path to NextGallery.exe. If not set, common install locations will be checked.
codecomfy.nextGalleryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the **NextGallery** companion viewer executable. Leave empty to auto-detect from common install locations (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\NextGallery`, `%PROGRAMFILES%\NextGallery`, and macOS/Linux equivalents). NextGallery is optional — CodeComfy works without it.

codecomfy.comfyuiUrl.markdownDescription: URL of the ComfyUI server. **Default:** `http://127.0.0.1:8188`. Change if ComfyUI runs on a remote machine or non-standard port. [ComfyUI install guide](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI#installing)

codecomfy.ffmpegPath.description: Absolute path to FFmpeg executable. Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH.
codecomfy.ffmpegPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to FFmpeg executable. **Required for video generation.** Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH. [Download FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html). Common Windows locations: `C:\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe`.

codecomfy.autoOpenGalleryOnComplete.description: Automatically open NextGallery when generation completes.
codecomfy.autoOpenGalleryOnComplete.markdownDescription: Automatically open [NextGallery](https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/nextgallery) when generation completes. The gallery is optional — set to `false` if you prefer to open outputs manually.

codecomfy.defaultNegativePrompt.description: Default negative prompt pre-filled during generation. Common values: blurry, distorted, low quality, text, watermark.
codecomfy.defaultNegativePrompt.markdownDescription: Default negative prompt pre-filled during generation. Describes what to **avoid** in the output. Common values: `blurry, distorted, low quality, text, watermark, deformed hands`. See the [ComfyUI prompt guide](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI#workflow-examples) for examples.

codecomfy.defaultCheckpoint.description: Override the model checkpoint baked into shipped HQ presets. Filename from your ComfyUI models/checkpoints/ directory. Leave empty to use the preset's built-in default.
codecomfy.defaultCheckpoint.markdownDescription: Override the model checkpoint baked into the **shipped HQ presets** (`hq-image`, `hq-video`). Set to a `.safetensors` filename from your `ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/` directory (e.g. `sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors`). Leave empty to use each preset's built-in default (requires `juggernautXL_v9Rundiffusionphoto2.safetensors`). If generation fails with a 'model not found' error, set this to a checkpoint you actually have installed.

codecomfy.notifyOnComplete.description: Show a notification when generation completes.
codecomfy.notifyOnComplete.markdownDescription: Show a notification when generation completes. Set to `false` for silent status-bar-only updates. Errors are always shown regardless.

scripts.verify: npm test && npm run compile && npx vsce package --no-dependencies
